text:
Samir: Heads up -- Tenant yz-128 is hitting repeated pod startup failures on the dedicated pool eu-west-1. Model inference pods crash during KV-cache restore. RequestID=rid_0x9f23a, pod=inf-xyz-2-5, node=gpu-eu-12. Seeing OOM during init then CUDA errors. Can SRE grab node dmesg + GPU counters and we need a repro curl so support can reproduce? :eyes:

Anya: Thanks Samir. Can you share the exact curl that triggers it? Also paste the model name and typical seq len. If we have the requestID I'll try to replay on our dedicated staging cluster and capture the failure window.

Samir: Sending curl below. Model: llama-13b-q4_kv. seq_len ~2048. Repro curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-13b-q4_kv","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":1400,"request_id":"rid_0x9f23a"}'
```

Anya: Trying replay now on staging-dedicated. If it fails I'll request a debug bundle from the node and ask infra to collect /var/log/messages, kubelet logs, container stdout/stderr, and nvidia-smi samples.

Kevin: Oncall here. I'll grab node telemetry. Running `sudo journalctl -u kubelet -S '1 hour ago' > /tmp/kubelet.log` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,memory.used --format=csv -l 1 > /tmp/gpu-sample.csv`. Also will capture `dmesg` and any XID codes. Will upload to the shared support bucket when done.

SRE-Oncall: Please run the debug-bundle helper on the node: `/opt/redwood/support/debug-bundle.sh --pod inf-xyz-2-5 --out /tmp/bundle-rid_0x9f23a.tar.gz` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/bundle-rid_0x9f23a.tar.gz s3://redwood-support/repro-bundles/rid_0x9f23a/`. Ping me when uploaded.

SupportBot: Checklist for this repro: 1) curl repro (Anya) 2) pod logs `kubectl logs -c runtime inf-xyz-2-5` (Samir) 3) node dmesg + nvidia-smi timeseries (Kevin) 4) debug bundle in S3 (SRE-Oncall). Mark status here as you complete each step.

Samir: Pushed pod logs: s3://redwood-support/repro-bundles/rid_0x9f23a/pod-logs.txt. Short `kubectl describe pod` excerpt:

```
Name:         inf-xyz-2-5
Namespace:    tenant-yz
Status:       CrashLoopBackOff
Containers:
  runtime:
    State:       Waiting
    Reason:      CrashLoopBackOff
    Last Exit:   OOMKilled while restoring kv cache
```

Anya: Replayed on staging, saw same KV-restore OOM at ~1300 tokens. Attaching stack trace snippet to the bundle. Recommendation: try smaller kv-shard or raise reserved host memory for the container while we correlate with node telemetry. cc @Kevin for GPU memory patterns.

Kevin: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-support/repro-bundles/rid_0x9f23a/node-bundle.tar.gz. dmesg shows repeated XID 13 GPU faults during large memcpy operations around the same timestamps. Also saw a recent kernel upgrade on gpu-eu-12 two days ago. Opening infra ticket — tagging `infra/driver-team`.

SRE-Oncall: Good find. Next steps: (a) canary a rollback to the previous NVIDIA driver on one node and run the same curl against that node (b) if no fault, plan controlled roll of remaining nodes, (c) if fault persists on old driver, escalate to runtime team for further memory handling fixes. I'll create the incident and include all bundle links.

Samir: Thanks everyone — marking this thread for follow-up. I'll keep tenant on a temporary capacity bump to avoid customer impact until infra confirms. :thumbsup:
